run_pump_source_file: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate C++ boilerplate code
convert_pump_to_cpp: convert a .pump template file to generated C++ code using ConvertFromPumpSource
parse_pump_ast: parse Pump source text into an AST using ParseToAST for meta programming
tokenize_pump_code: tokenize Pump source code into tokens using the Tokenize generator function
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated code by wrapping long lines with BeautifyCode to 80 columns
